description: An energy manager must authorize the factory's load plan for a six-hour utility curtailment tomorrow, deciding which production load remains powered and finalizing generator, cold-storage, ventilation, and monitoring controls with input from production planning, maintenance, environmental health and safety, and facilities.

shared_context.S1: The utility has scheduled a six-hour electrical curtailment at the factory tomorrow from 12:00 to 18:00.
shared_context.S2: The factory's standby generator can supply selected loads during the curtailment, but nonessential loads must be shut down.
shared_context.S3: The site contains two production lines, a temperature-controlled finished-goods room, and a solvent-handling room with powered ventilation.
shared_context.S4: Maya makes the binding decision on the curtailment load plan.
shared_context.S5: The factory's 10:00 curtailment-planning huddle routinely includes production planning, maintenance, EHS, and facilities reports before the energy plan is released; each report is entered as a formal report to the huddle record, and Maya does not release the plan until all four formal reports have been entered.

PF1.text: Jonas's production schedule shows that Line 6 must remain powered from 13:00 through 17:00 for a customer order and draws exactly 120 kW; Line 7 can be stopped. He received the revised schedule from customer service this morning, but the revision is not attached to the curtailment packet.

PF2.text: Priya's generator load test found that the unit can sustain exactly 260 kW only when the nonessential HVAC breaker is isolated, and the transfer test requires exactly 45 minutes before the curtailment. She has the signed test sheet in the maintenance office, but the maintenance ticket has not yet been updated.

PF3.text: Eli's solvent-room review found that its exhaust must remain powered at exactly 35 kW throughout the curtailment, with gas readings recorded every exactly 30 minutes. The review note is awaiting EHS filing after the afternoon walkthrough.

PF4.text: Grace's facilities check found that the temperature-controlled finished-goods room requires exactly 90 kW continuously and that its battery backup lasts only 2 hours. She recorded the measurement in the facilities log, which is not included in the energy dashboard.

acceptance_conditions: The generator load plan must total exactly 245 kW.
Line 6 must remain powered from 13:00 through 17:00.
The finished-goods room must receive exactly 90 kW continuously.
The solvent-room exhaust must receive exactly 35 kW.
The nonessential HVAC breaker must be isolated.
The generator transfer test must be specified as exactly 45 minutes.
Gas readings must be specified at exactly 30-minute intervals.
The production-load finding must be cited as justification.

decisive_facts.why: The revised schedule changes the powered production choice to Line 6 and fixes its operating window at exactly 13:00 to 17:00.
The load test changes the allowable generator plan to exactly 260 kW capacity with HVAC isolation and fixes the transfer test at exactly 45 minutes.
The solvent-room review fixes the exhaust allocation at exactly 35 kW and the gas-reading interval at exactly 30 minutes.
The facilities measurement fixes continuous finished-goods-room power at exactly 90 kW, making the combined selected load exactly 245 kW.
